blocks.text: Athleisure is a casual style that prevalently originated in the Late 2010s, diffusing athletic gear with streetwear to create functional, highly versatile, and comfortable everyday outfits. This fashion approach leans on elevated performance fabrics such as tech fleece, ribbed knits, and spandex styled alongside tailored pieces, structured outerwear, and premium footwear.
Footwear Focus: Chunky retro trainers, athletic slides, or clean lifestyle sneakers finish the look.
Structured Layers: Leather jackets, tailored blazers, robes, rench coats, and oversized hoodies bridge the gap between streetwear and gym attire.
High-Quality Basics: Bike shorts, joggers, sports bras and leggings serve as the baseline foundation.
Tonal and Minimalist Comfort: Leaning on soft textures, clean lines, and matching sets, features cohesive neutral color palettes and high-quality fabrics for a polished appearance.

Active Casual & Performance: This style focuses on classic sports elements such as versatile joggers, breathable tech layers and track jackets meant for a seamless transition from workouts to social standards.
Elevated Street Style: This approach associates dramatic, structured outerwear with ultra-casual activewear to create high-contrast silhouettes that are perfect for city transit.
Monochromatic Palettes: Neutral colors such as cream, black, heather grey, and olive green make matching and mixing effortless.
